segments.title: 2015 mandate — sunny ways meet the machine
segments.narration: A majority Liberal government promises transparency, reconciliation, and middle-class growth. The film scores promises against later ethics findings, AG reports, and statutory outcomes — not campaign video.

segments.title: Carter and Bill C-14 — MAID enters statute
segments.narration: The Supreme Court strikes the absolute ban on assistance in dying. Parliament enacts C-14. Health Canada annual reports will become the primary body-count ledger. This is the legal hinge for the later expansion arc tracked in Acts six through nine.

segments.title: SNC-Lavalin — pressure on a Attorney General
segments.narration: The ethics commissioner's report and committee drama document pressure regarding a deferred prosecution agreement. Resignations follow. The case is a primary ethics-process exhibit for modern PMO-minister relations.

segments.title: MMIWG inquiry — genocide finding
segments.narration: The National Inquiry into Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls issues a genocide finding and calls for justice. Implementation remains a live accountability metric against federal and provincial responses.

segments.title: Lobbying industrial complex — the always-on layer
segments.narration: Registry data shows continuous pressure on health, finance, defence, and tech files. The film treats lobbying not as spice but as structural input to legislation — cross-linked to MAID, procurement, and foreign influence tracks.

segments.title: TRC Final Report — cultural genocide finding
segments.narration: The Truth and Reconciliation Commission documents residential schools as cultural genocide. Ninety-four Calls to Action become a public scoreboard governments still fail to complete on schedule. The finding is Canada's own commission speaking — not foreign propaganda.

segments.title: Carter and Bill C-14 — MAID legalized
segments.narration: Carter v Canada strikes down the absolute ban on assisted death. Bill C-14 creates medical assistance in dying under narrow conditions. Every later expansion starts from this hinge. Health Canada's annual reports will become the death ledger of the film.

segments.title: MMIWG Inquiry — genocide finding
segments.narration: The National Inquiry into Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls finds genocide. Governments accept and then under-deliver. The film treats this as a second official genocide finding in four years — TRC and MMIWG — not as rhetoric.
